name: openwam-put-bottles-v1-s0-30k-4xh200-direct-20260910-v2
command:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
export OPENWAM_TRAIN_ROOT=/inspire/hdd3/project/agent-driven-world-model/ky26300/manimux_training
export OPENWAM_WORKSPACE="$OPENWAM_TRAIN_ROOT/operate/manimux-openwam"
export OPENWAM_PYTHON="$OPENWAM_TRAIN_ROOT/envs/openwam/.venv/bin/python"
export OPENWAM_GPU_IDS=0,1,2,3
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export WANDB_DISABLED=true
test "$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l)" -eq 4
"$OPENWAM_PYTHON" -c "import torch; devices=list(range(torch.cuda.device_count())); print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, devices); assert len(devices)==4"
bash "$OPENWAM_WORKSPACE/scripts/training/train_openwam_yam_bottles_cluster.sh" train put-bottles-openwam-v1-s0-30k
'
description: OpenWAM YAM put-bottles direct formal train; 50 episodes/35118 frames; native EEF20 next-achieved-state targets; foundation SHA256 180a02653118b0f96da28a9cae9ec7b4c1c1e6cd0e4608b56c7b4884f8001d3d; 30000 global/micro-steps (3750 optimizer updates); save every 5000 global steps; per-GPU batch1, grad accumulation8, seed0; no W&B; task priority 5.
